entries.title: Watered Every Day, Still Wilting. Why?

moments.what: Pick the fix: check every part, water it more, or feed it?
A plant makes its own food in its leaves, using light
Look closer: the leaves, the stem, the soil and the roots
Wet soil, thirsty plant: roots need air to absorb water
A plant is a system: one part stops, the whole plant is affected
The real fix: holes in the pot; water when the top is dry
Be a drop of water: the stem transports water, salts and food
The words that earn marks: roots, stem and leaves
